# Vendored GSAP

This folder stores local copies of GSAP files used by Jam Tracks Hub.

- `gsap.min.js`: GSAP 3.13.0
- `ScrollTrigger.min.js`: ScrollTrigger 3.13.0
- `Flip.min.js`: Flip 3.13.0
- `SplitText.min.js`: SplitText 3.13.0

Source: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.13.0/dist/`

License terms are preserved in each minified file header.
